message.content:
It sounds like you’re thinking about Boston’s heat, but the numbers don’t line up with what we actually see there. Boston’s average high in July (the hottest month) is usually around **70–75 °F (21–24 °C)**. Even on the warmest days, temperatures rarely climb above **90 °F (32 °C)**. A “54 °C” reading would be far beyond anything the city experiences—such temperatures are typical of deserts or tropical regions, not New England.

If you’re planning a trip or just curious about how Boston’s climate compares to other places, let me know! I can give you more detailed stats, historical records, or even tips for staying cool.
